user.title: Notion Todo List
user.description: Create a Home Assistant todo list from a Notion database. filter_json and sorts_json are passed directly to Notion's database query API.

data_description.update_seconds: How often Home Assistant polls Notion for this list. Minimum 15 seconds.
data_description.default_property: Optional Notion property name to set on every new task, for example Assignee, Owner, Priority, Project.
data_description.default_value: Value for that property. For people/relation fields use the Notion user/page ID; for select/status use the option name.

error.auth: Authentication failed. Check the Notion token and database sharing.
error.invalid_json: Filter or sorts JSON is invalid.

init.title: Edit Notion Todo List
init.description: Edit polling, property names, filters/sorts, and defaults for newly created tasks. To change Database ID, add a new integration entry.
